description: This file defines a React component 'ProviderSpecificFields' that manages and renders provider-specific credential input fields in a form. It includes functions for mapping metadata, creating credentials, caching provider fields, and handling file uploads, along with hooks to fetch provider metadata and synchronize caches.

classes.name: ProviderSpecificFields
classes.description: React functional component for rendering provider-specific credential input fields, managing cache, loading metadata, and handling file uploads.

methods.name: mapFieldMetadataToUiField
methods.description: Converts provider credential metadata into UI field configuration for rendering.

methods.name: createCredentialFromModel
methods.description: Generates a CredentialItem object from a provider name and model data, mapping field values accordingly.
